## Indian Gen Z survey names Spotify among top streaming subscription salary expenditures

Gen Z subscription stickiness in India supports the demographic demand tailwind and emerging-market subscriber growth thesis for SPOT, but the single-market, single-cohort survey scope limits how much weight it carries for near-term numbers.

- Indian consumer survey finds Gen Z allocating meaningful salary share to streaming subscriptions.
- Spotify named alongside JioHotstar and Netflix as prominent Gen Z subscription choices in India.
- Points to subscription consumption normalization among younger demographics in an emerging market.
- Survey scope is India-specific; direct extrapolation to global SPOT subscriber or revenue thesis requires caution.
